honest_scope: The Fourier-block rank theorem is an algebraic proof for odd prime powers. The E8 map is a primitive integral control/payload intertwiner whose projected differential agrees with raw incidence modulo two on the control chains.
title: Five Levi next closures: rank theorem, trade module, E8 intertwiner, fault stack, and runtime G-sets

proof.field_extension: Extend scalars from F2 to a splitting field K for the odd additive group C=(F_q,+). Because |C|=q is odd, Maschke decomposition into additive-character blocks preserves rank.

nontrivial_character_block.incidence_image: Fourier-transformed line columns are symmetric rank-one/chirp matrices; diagonal columns and their polarizations span Sym_q(K).
nontrivial_character_block.line_gram_rank: On Sym_q the Frobenius Gram pairing cancels every off-diagonal pair twice, leaving only the q diagonal coordinates; hence rank q.
nontrivial_character_block.point_operator: After finite Fourier conjugation, A_P,chi is Y -> Y + Y^T on Mat_q(K).
nontrivial_character_block.point_rank: q(q-1)/2, the dimension of zero-diagonal symmetric matrices in characteristic two.

proof.scope: This is an algebraic proof for every odd prime power q, not an extrapolation from the four census orders.

trivial_character_block.incidence_kernel: M_0(z,w)=0 iff w=Ez and sum(z)=0; nullity q, hence rank q^2+q+1.
trivial_character_block.line_kernel: The Gram equations leave rank q+1.
trivial_character_block.model: The fixed block is the affine plane AG(2,q), with point-line incidence N and direction repeater E.
trivial_character_block.point_kernel: Explicit elimination gives nullity q(q+1), hence point rank q^2+1.
